# Copilot repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first and use the canonical `.agents/skills` tree, including `netscript-harness`
for harnessed work. Do not duplicate skills into another tree. Follow the selected run's plan,
worklog, and supervisor routing; a cloud assignment does not authorize scope expansion.

Never self-certify generated work: evaluator session and vendor family must differ. Preserve
lockfiles and unrelated changes; do not introduce lockfile churn, workflow edits, repository-setting
changes, or secrets. Use scoped structured validation wrappers and record exact-head evidence.

OpenHands remains available. CI approval, steering comments, and UI cancellation remain explicit
human actions. Agent Tasks live creation is disabled in this Pro+ integration; do not bypass it.
